description: Search, inspect, read, and create WPS cloud files through the official WPS MCP service.

auth.label: WPS Access Token
auth.placeholder: Paste your WPS MCP access token
auth.description: Access Token sent to WPS MCP as an Authorization bearer token. Sign in and copy the Token from https://account.wps.cn/usercenter/agent-identity?isclient=false.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current WPS MCP tool with JSON arguments after checking its live schema and behavior annotations.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current WPS MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the WPS MCP tool.

actions.name: create_file_with_content
actions.description: Create a WPS document, PDF, spreadsheet, or smart sheet and populate it with JSON-friendly content.

name.description: The complete file name, such as Weekly Report.docx.

file_extension.description: The file extension without a leading dot.

content.description: UTF-8 Markdown content for OTL, DOCX, or PDF files.

drive_id.description: The destination WPS drive ID. Defaults to the personal drive.

parent_id.description: The destination folder ID. Defaults to the root folder 0.

items.description: A WPS spreadsheet range with coordinates and a formula or value.
A smart sheet field containing at least a name and type.
A smart sheet record containing a fields object.

sheet_name.description: The destination spreadsheet or smart sheet name.

inputSchema.description: The new WPS file name, type, location, and format-specific content.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the current WPS MCP tool.

actions.name: create_folder
actions.description: Create a folder in a known WPS drive and parent folder.

parent_id.description: The parent folder ID. Use 0 for the drive root.

name.description: The folder name without a file extension.

on_name_conflict.description: How WPS should handle an existing name.

items.description: A folder name in the relative path.

parent_path.description: Relative folder path segments that WPS should create when missing.

inputSchema.description: The destination and name for a new WPS folder.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the current WPS MCP tool.

actions.name: get_file_info
actions.description: Get metadata, drive details, extended attributes, or permissions for a WPS file.

file_id.description: A WPS file ID used to select the document.

link_id.description: A WPS share link ID used to select the document.

url.description: A WPS document URL used to select the document.

with_drive.description: Whether the response should include the containing drive.

with_ext_attrs.description: Whether the response should include extended attributes.

with_permission.description: Whether the response should include operation permissions.

inputSchema.description: At least one WPS file selector and optional metadata expansions.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the current WPS MCP tool.

actions.name: list_files
actions.description: List entries in a known WPS drive folder with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

parent_id.description: The folder ID. Use 0 for the drive root.

filter_exts.description: Comma-separated lowercase file extensions to include.

type.description: The kind of file system entry to include.

filter_type.description: An optional file system entry type filter.

order_by.description: The field used to sort entries.

page_token.description: The pagination token returned by the previous request.

with_ext_attrs.description: Whether each entry should include extended attributes.

with_permission.description: Whether each entry should include operation permissions.

inputSchema.description: The WPS drive folder and optional listing controls.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the current WPS MCP tool.

actions.name: list_my_files
actions.description: List entries in the root of the connected user's WPS cloud documents with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

filter_exts.description: Comma-separated lowercase file extensions to include.

type.description: The kind of file system entry to include.

filter_type.description: An optional file system entry type filter.

order_by.description: The field used to sort entries.

page_token.description: The pagination token returned by the previous request.

with_ext_attrs.description: Whether each entry should include extended attributes.

with_permission.description: Whether each entry should include operation permissions.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for the WPS cloud document root.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the current WPS MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current WPS document, spreadsheet, presentation, PDF, and workspace MCP tools with their live input schemas.

name.description: The exact WPS MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by WPS MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside WPS.

annotations.description: MCP hints supplied by WPS about a tool's behavior.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by WPS MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected WPS MCP account.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed to the connected WPS MCP account.

outputSchema.description: The current WPS MCP tool catalog.

actions.name: read_file
actions.description: Read a WPS cloud document as Markdown, plain text, structured KDC data, or spreadsheet cells according to its format.

file_id.description: A WPS file ID used to select the document.

link_id.description: A WPS share link ID used to select the document.

url.description: A WPS document URL used to select the document.

format.description: The output format for supported text documents.

enable_upload_medias.description: Whether extracted media should be uploaded and returned as temporary download URLs.

sheet_id.description: The numeric spreadsheet sheet ID. It takes priority over sheet_name.

sheet_range.description: A zero-based inclusive spreadsheet cell range.

task_id.description: The task ID returned by a previous incomplete read request.

inputSchema.description: At least one WPS file selector and format-specific reading options. When several selectors are supplied, WPS prioritizes url, then link_id, then file_id.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the current WPS MCP tool.

actions.name: search_files
actions.description: Search WPS cloud documents and folders across drives by file name, content, creator, location, type, or time.

file_type.description: The kind of file system entry to include.

parent_ids.description: Folder IDs that constrain the search.

file_exts.description: File extensions to include without leading dots.

exclude_file_exts.description: File extensions to exclude without leading dots.

file_ext_groups.description: WPS file extension groups to include.

device_ids.description: Device IDs associated with included files.

creator_ids.description: WPS user IDs whose files should be included.

modifier_ids.description: WPS user IDs that last modified included files.

receiver_ids.description: WPS user IDs that received included files.

sharer_ids.description: WPS user IDs that shared included files.

scope.description: WPS search scopes such as all or share_by_me.

filter_user_id.description: The WPS creator or sharer filter expected by the MCP tool.

search_operator_name.description: Whether creator and sharer names should participate in the search.

start_time.description: The minimum creation or modification time expected by WPS.

end_time.description: The maximum creation or modification time expected by WPS.

time_type.description: The timestamp field used by the time range.

order_by.description: The field used to sort search results.

page_size.description: The page size from 0 to 500. WPS treats zero as 50.

page_token.description: The pagination token returned by the previous search.

with_drive.description: Whether each result should include drive details.

with_link.description: Whether each result should include share link details.

with_permission.description: Whether each result should include operation permissions.

with_total.description: Whether the response should include the total result count.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for searching WPS cloud documents.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the current WPS MCP tool.
